question: Two trains of lengths 250 metres and 400 metres are running at speeds of 40 km/h and 30 km/h, respectively. If they are moving in the same direction, they will cross each other in ________ minutes.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Relative Speed** in same direction = 40 − 30 = 10 km/h.

**Total Distance** to cover = Sum of train lengths = 250 + 400 = 650 m.

Convert speed to m/s: 10 × (5/18) = 25/9 m/s.

**Time** in seconds = Distance ÷ Speed = 650 ÷ (25/9) = 234 s.

**Time** in minutes = 234 ÷ 60 = 3.9 min.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.9 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of first train (L₁) = 250 m, Speed (S₁) = 40 km/h

Length of second train (L₂) = 400 m, Speed (S₂) = 30 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = (L₁ + L₂) ÷ (S₁ − S₂) [When moving in the **same direction**]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9db46539dcecfd7a3c18a4510c9fe359d10a187f52dc98d02d71e008fd3e0ea.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total distance = 250 + 400 = 650 m

⇒ Relative speed = (40 − 30) × (5/18) m/s

⇒ Relative speed = 10 × (5/18) = 25/9 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 650 ÷ (25/9) seconds

⇒ Time taken = (650 × 9) ÷ 25 = 26 × 9 = 234 seconds

⇒ Converting seconds to minutes: 234 ÷ 60

⇒ Time taken = 3.9 min

**∴ The correct answer is 3.9 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Rules

When two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. When they move in **opposite directions**, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from **km/h to m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert from **m/s to km/h**, multiply by 18/5.

Total Distance for Trains

While crossing each other, the **total distance** is always the sum of the lengths of both trains, regardless of the direction of motion.</p
